tables.name: Rooms
tables.description: The keep's rooms: rolled for each room beyond its starting rooms (BSM x floors, the cellar counting, modified by Condition). Repeated rooms may be multiples, or larger or better versions.

results.name: Bedroom
results.description: Area designated for resting, containing a bed or beds. Can sleep up to two people.

results.name: Dining and Receiving
results.description: General area with tables, as well as benches and/or chairs.

results.name: Kitchen
results.description: Area for cooking and food preparation. (Additional rolls may be spent to generate a ‘Larder’.)

results.name: Chapel
results.description: Area designated for worship, meditation, or spiritual instruction.

results.name: Guard Bunks
results.description: Quarters for guards and their equipment.

results.name: Equipment Storage
results.description: Storage for household equipment, as well as defensive implements, if there are no barracks.

results.name: Guest Quarters
results.description: Area set aside for guest occupation.

results.name: Larder
results.description: Food storage, typically placed in the cellar where it stays cool.

results.name: Library
results.description: Area for records, books, and/or study.

results.name: Privy
results.description: Indoor alternative to a separate outhouse.

results.name: Solar
results.description: Living/recreational room for the main resident(s). Comes with a bed, can sleep up to 2 people.

results.name: Stables
results.description: Houses mounts for residents and visitors. (Attached to the outer wall of the keep.)

results.name: Servant Quarters
results.description: Area for a servant (or servants) to sleep and store their possessions. Exclusively servants' quarters: servants equal to the BSM; shared: BSM - 1 (at least 1).
